text:
A current in a solenoid produces a uniform magnetic field inside the solenoid. The magnetic field
direction is due east.
Which changes will produce a stronger magnetic field with a direction due west?
Use a smaller current and turn the solenoid through 180°.
A
B
Use a smaller current and reverse the current.
Use a larger current and turn the solenoid through 90°.
C
D
Use a larger current and reverse the current.

options.label: A
options.text: Use a smaller current and turn the solenoid through 180°.

options.label: B
options.text: Use a smaller current and reverse the current.

options.label: C
options.text: Use a larger current and turn the solenoid through 90°.

options.label: D
options.text: Use a larger current and reverse the current.
